purpose: Demonstrate that a provider module physically outside the repository can be loaded by module:factory without editing the built-in registry or generic R harmonizer.
claim_boundary: Plugin architectures are prior art. This evidence supports only SuRT-GeoHarmonizer's implemented decoupling between provider preparation and its fixed harmonization contract.

method.module_location: runtime temporary directory outside repository root
checks: temporary module is physically outside repository root
module factory loads through provider adapter boundary
malformed repository fixture adapter remains fail-closed
